dataset.name: FEI Face Database (original color images)
dataset.use_terms: FEI permits research use; redistribution or reproduction of the database is not permitted.

protocol.description: Fixed seed 20261108; 100 known identities with 4 gallery, 5 validation, and 5 test images each; 50 validation-only and 50 test-only unknown identities with 14 images each; exact SHA-256 duplicates excluded and within-person OpenCV pHash clusters (Hamming <= 2) kept intact; capture sessions not documented; image-level still-image benchmark.
protocol.capture_sessions: Not documented by source; image-level still-image benchmark, no session grouping.
protocol.near_duplicate_screen: Exact SHA-256 duplicates grouped; within-person OpenCV pHash pairs at Hamming distance <= 2 kept in the same split.

model.threshold_source: Selected on validation and locked before test.
model.camera: FEI still-image database; capture camera/lens not documented
model.device: Local Linux x86_64 CPU; OpenCV 4.14.0; Python 3.14.10

scope_note: This FEI still-image benchmark has no documented capture sessions or camera/lens metadata; it does not validate performance under the project's live camera protocol.
